retrievalLimitations: No current comprehensive official priority text for every simultaneous enter-play, evolve, retreat and switch interaction was newly obtained.
No PTCG Live behavior or log is treated as a rules authority or used for this implementation.
No Japanese, Asian or community source is mixed into the international ruleset.
implementationLimits: Supports audited ON_ENTER_PLAY, ON_EVOLVE, ON_RETREAT and ON_SWITCH programs for Pokémon, Tool, Stadium and Special Energy sources.
Opening setup, mulligan bonus Bench placement and Knock Out replacement intentionally do not produce these ordinary field-change events.
Full simultaneous-trigger priority, leave-play replacement effects and last-known-information predicates remain unsupported and reject unaudited card programs.
